_comment: The dungeons of the divine dimensions: one room, its boss fought in waves (Managers/DimensionDungeons.cs).
The rules are the same for all of them, after Dofus pour les noobs' pages of these dungeons; the
Osavora ones, written for Dofus 3, state them most fully. Five waves, the next one every five turns
(turns 1, 6, 11, 16 and 21) or at once when nobody is left in front. Each wave has as many monsters
as there are fighters, and the first is led by the boss. Every monster that comes in is invulnerable
until the end of its first turn, and from the second wave on it comes with a quarter less life.
INFERRED: the state that makes them invulnerable (56, the client's own «Invulnerable»), the size of
a wave for fewer than four people (the modular dungeons' four), and who comes in the later waves
(drawn from the boss room's own monsters, as its group is). «beside»: the monsters a dungeon's boss
starts the fight with, once, right after him in the room's group, and never in the later waves.

dungeons.name: Palacio del Rey Nidas
dungeons.why: King Nidas starts beside his Bobolsa Enemiga (3649): Dofus pour les noobs has her next to the boss at the start, change sides once she falls and bring her Cadeau empoisonné, and the boss's Mi Tesoro (4494) only aims at her (F3649,F3650). Her subarea (825) does not list her, so the room's group never had her. Her own behaviour (her grade's starting spell, Bolsazo 4484) casts Cambio de Campo on her death, which brings her back as the Bobolsa Aliada (3650) on the other side. She comes with the boss's wave, once, and never in the later ones.

dungeons.name: Memoria de Orukam
dungeons.why: Dofus pour les noobs («Mémoire d'Orukam»): not one of the Twelve's, but in the Dragon's dimension, so it is fought like theirs with only three waves, in a single fight. It writes them out for four people: King Imagami with Imorok, Imafugo and Imetsu (6468, 6471, 6470: «beside»); then Imiyama, Imiyama, Imorok and Imafugo in 4 turns; then Imiyama, Imetsu, Imushin and Imushin in 5 more. One more monster per fighter past four (modular), drawn here from the wave's own. Newcomers are invulnerable for their first turn; the page gives no life cut for the later waves (every monster has a 13 500 life bonus instead), so they come whole.
